meta.sourceOfTruth: Live MICHELIN Guide all-starred list (pages 1-2) + individual MICHELIN restaurant pages + official restaurant websites/menu pages
meta.starCounts: 5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star = 69 starred (live filter counters, re-verified 2026-11-25). Plus 3 Guide-listed new-addition rows (no star) = 72 total rows.
meta.rosterReconciliation: The namespaced kit sessions/33cfdba4 carried 72 rows but 3 (Blue Hill at Stone Barns, Shion 69 Leonard Street, La Bastide by Andrea Calstier) are NOT in the live all-starred selection; excluded here and flagged. This canonical roster is the live 69 starred + 3 guide-listed.
meta.importantTiming: Michelin's 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony is scheduled for 2026-12-14 (https://michelinmedia.com/pages/blog/detail/article/c/a1479/), after this research and before the trip. Distinctions may change.
meta.priceNote: priceTwoAdults = 2 x a per-person price printed on an official restaurant page (menu/FAQ/booking channel); food only, before tax, tip and beverages unless noted. Arithmetic and the exact source URL are in priceNote/priceSourceUrl and on the Michelin page's price-verification table. A-la-carte restaurants and unreachable prices stay blank and flagged. Michelin's $ band is shown separately as guidePriceBand. Menus were captured Nov 2026; re-confirm for the Feb-Mar 2027 trip.
meta.hoursNote: Hours transcribed from MICHELIN detail pages or the restaurant's own site. Rows not yet transcribed are blank and flagged; the linked MICHELIN page shows the live schedule.
meta.socialNote: Social links labelled (official) were read from the restaurant's own site or its official booking channel. Third-party review links are labelled as such and are not official endorsements.
meta.hoursCrossCheck: Le Bernardin, Eleven Madison Park, Per Se and Atera were read independently by two sessions against the same MICHELIN records on 2026-11-25 and agree. The fuller capture (which includes Le Bernardin Thursday to Sunday and 'Sunday closed') is retained. Independent agreement is the strongest verification available without a second source.
